# CreativeLive

> CreativeLive is an online platform offering instructor-led creative classes in photography, videography, design, and video editing taught by industry professionals.

CreativeLive provides live and on-demand creative education courses spanning photography, videography, design, and digital arts. The platform features renowned instructors and emphasizes hands-on, project-based learning for creative professionals at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Photography Courses
- Videography
- Video Editing
